description:
Cast Glider Staff by paying {2}{W}.
When Glider Staff enters, it triggers, airbending Annie Flash.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Glider Staff, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Annie Flash from exile by paying {2}.
When Annie Flash enters, it triggers, returning Glider Staff from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
